capabilities: Index YAML properties and checkbox tasks from Markdown notes
Summarize subjects, deadlines, and overdue work in a Dashboard
Render a hierarchical Gantt chart with drag rescheduling
Prioritize work in Now, Next, Later, and Unscheduled buckets (Horizon)
Export dates to ICS files or project them to Google Calendar
disambiguation: Despite the neuro focus, it is a planning tool, not a clinical or medical product.
extras: Not yet published in the Community Plugin store; beta installs go through BRAT. Full documentation lives on separate linked pages. Donations via Revolut or Ko-fi do not unlock features, and maintenance is spare-time with no support commitments.
motivation: The author built it as a personal hobby project to solve problems in his own academic planning, then shared it publicly.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see subjects, deadlines, overdue work, and unscheduled tasks across a vault as a coordinated academic plan.

relations.evidence: optionally connect Google Calendar on desktop after configuring a Google OAuth client
beta testers can install the repository through BRAT

requires.name: Google account with own OAuth client

summary: Markdown-backed academic planning layer with Dashboard, hierarchical Gantt, and Horizon views, plus one-way ICS and Google Calendar export.
